python3 << 'EOF'
import os
import glob

files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.expanduser("~/.crew/tool-output/*.txt")))

categories = [
    "Documentation",
    "UX", 
    "Visual Design",
    "Configuration",
    "Animation"
]

with open("improvements.md", "w") as out:
    item_num = 1
    for i, filepath in enumerate(files):
        category = categories[i] if i < len(categories) else "Unknown"
        with open(filepath, "r") as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line and line[0].isdigit():
                    # Extract the text after the number
                    parts = line.split(". ", 1)
                    if len(parts) == 2:
                        text = parts[1]
                        out.write(f"## {category}\n\n")
                        out.write(f"{item_num}. {text}\n\n")
                        item_num += 1

print(f"Created improvements.md with {item_num-1} items")
